name: Cortello's Riddle
summary: In the Hinterlands, the final verses of Cortello's Riddle draw treasure hunters to the coast. A musty scroll points north from the southern tropics, and the trail ends beneath the waterfalls.

sections.title: The Final Clue
sections.body: The weathered verse turns the search north, away from the southern tropics and toward Lordaeron. There, amid the great turmoil of the embattled lands, the long chase reaches its end along the coast.

sections.title: Beneath the Cascade
sections.body: The final hoard lies along the Hinterlands shore. Search underwater at the foot of the great falls.

aliases: where do i go for cortello riddle 3
faq.answer: The verse leads to the coast of the Hinterlands in Lordaeron. Search underwater at the foot of the great waterfall pouring from the cliffs.

faq.q: What starts this part of the search?
aliases: how to start cortellos riddle part 3
where do i get the scroll
faq.answer: A musty scroll found during the earlier search for Cortello's treasure holds the final riddle.
Cortello left the riddles and hidden scrolls that lead searchers to his treasure.
